name: PowerBoard
subtitle: Mockups, diagrams, code export
promotionalText: Free, offline, no account. Draw app screens and flowcharts on one canvas, then export them as an image, a written spec, or working React and Tailwind code.
description:
PowerBoard is a design board for your Mac. Draw app screens and diagrams on the same canvas, then export what you made as an image, a written spec, or working code.

It runs offline. Boards are files on your own Mac, there is no account to create, and nothing is uploaded anywhere.

TWO KINDS OF WORK, ONE CANVAS

Build app mockups on device-sized frames using real interface pieces: nav bars, tab bars, lists, tables, cards, charts, inputs, sheets and dialogs. Frames can stack their contents for you, so a list of rows stays evenly spaced as you add to it.

Or draw flowcharts, org charts and process maps. Connectors attach to shapes and follow them when you move things around, routing around whatever is in the way. Sticky notes and freehand ink are there for the messy part.

Drop a screenshot onto the canvas and trace over it when you are redesigning something that already exists.

EXPORT SOMETHING YOU CAN USE

Any frame exports as PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF at the scale you choose. It also exports as React and Tailwind markup, as a written implementation spec, or as a Mermaid diagram, so what you designed can go straight to whoever builds it.

WORK WITH AN AI AGENT ON THE SAME BOARD

While PowerBoard is open it serves an endpoint on your own machine. Paste that one URL into an AI coding assistant that speaks the Model Context Protocol, ask it for a board, and it edits the same board you are looking at. Changes show up in an activity feed in plain language and light up on the canvas as they land. Right-click any element to leave a comment, and the agent can answer in the same thread. Nothing connects on its own, and quitting the app stops it.

YOUR WORK STAYS YOURS

Boards live in PowerBoard's own folder on your Mac and are saved as compressed snapshots you can roll back to. No accounts, no analytics, no advertising identifiers, no tracking of any kind. There is no trial and no subscription, and nothing is held back behind a purchase.
whatsNew:
Small fixes.

• Live updates on the canvas now keep working when PowerBoard is running on a custom port, instead of quietly dropping to "live sync unavailable".
• Fixed a status message that mentioned cloud saves while you were working locally, where there are none. It now tells you your change was saved on this Mac.
